title: Web-based shopkeeping sim with Fable and Opus 5
author: Novel-Cantaloupe8236
selftext:
For about the past month, I've been building a web-based game with Fable and Opus 5.

When I shared it before, it had become this hard-to-describe, game-like thing with a pretty vague concept: an open world with no real goal, where you just enjoy living alongside AI characters. So I added one clear objective. For now, I've turned it into a shop management sim. You open tea houses and other shops in towns around the map and try to build them into successful businesses. That's the simple idea.

The part I put the most effort into was modeling the map. During this month, people shared all kinds of great repositories and vibe-modeling tips, so I used those as references and did my best to model a whole new set of original assets and maps for the game.

The animations still aren't great, but I made it possible for the player to serve customers directly. I also added purchasing, bank loans, and a few things to spice up the business side, like bad weather, rival shops, and theft.

Vibe-modeling the map is so much fun that I keep getting completely hooked on it, and then I neglect the actual content of the game. It's becoming a bit of a problem lol.

Next, I'm planning to work on the story properly, add more events, and expand the city maps. I have about three more map models sitting around, but they aren't playable yet. Honestly, I also want to make the management side much deeper!

I'd love to hear any feedback!
